text_en: Bel bows down, Nebo stoops, their idols are on beasts and cattle; these things you carry are loaded as burdens on weary animals.
text_cn: 贝耳塌下了，乃波倾倒了，他们的神像，负在走兽和牲口身上；他们的重载，重压着筋疲的畜类。

text_en: They stoop, they bow down together; they cannot save the burden, but themselves go into captivity.
text_cn: 他们都一齐倾倒了，塌下了，神像不但不能救助驮运他们的畜类，甚至连自己也该流徙远配。

text_en: Listen to me, O house of Jacob, all the remnant of the house of Israel, who have been borne by me from your birth, carried from the womb;
text_cn: 雅各伯家啊！以色列家所有的遗民啊！请你们听我：自出母胎我就抱着你，自离母腹我就怀着你；

text_en: even to your old age I am he, even when you turn gray I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear; I will carry and will save.
text_cn: 直到你年老，我仍是一样；直到你白头，我依然扶持你。我既然如此做了，我必要提携你，扶持你，拯救你。

text_en: To whom will you liken me and make me equal, and compare me, as though we were alike?
text_cn: 你们拿我同谁比拟，与谁相等，跟谁比较，以求我们相同呢？

text_en: Those who lavish gold from the purse, and weigh out silver in the scales— they hire a goldsmith, who makes it into a god; then they fall down and worship!
text_cn: 有些人从钱囊中把金子倒出，放银子在天平上衡量；以后雇了一个金匠，制造了一个神像，遂向它屈膝朝拜；

text_en: They lift it to their shoulders, they carry it, they set it in its place, and it stands there; it cannot move from its place. If one cries out to it, it does not answer or save anyone from trouble.
text_cn: 又将神像抬起，放在肩上扛着，以后安置在一个地方，它就立在那里，再不能离开那地方；人呼求它，它也不答应，也不能救人脱离灾殃。

text_en: Remember this and consider, recall it to mind, you transgressors,
text_cn: 你们应记住这事，应站稳！叛逆的人啊！你们应记在心头！

text_en: remember the former things of old; for I am God, and there is no other; I am God, and there is no one like me,
text_cn: 你们应追忆以前古时所发生的事，因为我是天主，没有另一个；我是天主，没有与我相似的；

text_en: declaring the end from the beginning and from ancient times things not yet done, saying, “My purpose shall stand, and I will fulfill my intention, ”
text_cn: 我从起初就预言了末后的事，早就宣布了未来的事；我如今说：“我的计划必要成功，我的旨意都要实现；”

text_en: calling a bird of prey from the east, the man for my purpose from a far country. I have spoken, and I will bring it to pass; I have planned, and I will do it.
text_cn: 我要把老鹰从东方召来， 把履行我计划的人由远方叫来；我说了，必要去行；我决定了，必要去做。

text_en: Listen to me, you stubborn of heart, you who are far from deliverance:
text_cn: 心硬的人！远离正义的人！听我说吧！

text_en: I bring near my deliverance, it is not far off, and my salvation will not tarry; I will put salvation in Zion, for Israel my glory.
text_cn: 我的仁义来近了，已不远了，我的救恩不再延迟；我必在熙雍赐与救恩，把我的光荣赐给以色列。
